taylor: Quick broadcast 10: we're testing a new quiet-window SLO weighting tonight 00:30-01:30 UTC. This affects best-effort traffic only. No customer-facing API change.

sam: whats the exact change?

cecil: pinging infra-bot for the diff.

infra-bot: Config change queued: `slo-weighting/quiet-window-v2` 
- best_effort.p99 target: 150ms -> 170ms during window
- premium.p99 unchanged
- auto-fallback throttle reduced from 12s -> 6s
CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/5890

nina: will we run a canary?

taylor: yes, 5% traffic -> 25% -> rollback or full. Canary window 00:30-00:55. Traffic-sim scheduled.

sam: alert changes? need to avoid noisy pages.

cecil: I lowered infra/p99 alert to fire at 180ms for canary tag. I'll push the alert PR now.

sam: link?

cecil: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/1011

infra-bot: Scheduled: traffic-sim-quiet-window-20260410 at 2026-04-10T00:30:00Z. Runner: sim-3.

taylor: ops checklist (short):
- warm KV prefixes: `scripts/warm_kv.sh --prefix=quiet-v2`
- tag canary: `env=canary_quiet_v2`
- monitor: p99, 5xx, client-retries
- abort: `!abort-quiet-window` in this thread

nina: I'll be watching dashboards from 00:20-01:40 UTC. Paging window set.

sam: CS notification?

taylor: notifying CS only on rollback. If we see sustained 5xx >0.15% for 10m I'll ping @cs.

cecil: small note if we hit higher client retries we might need to bump token-bucket limits on canary pool. I have a quick patch prepped.

infra-bot: Reminder: postmortem template created at /docs/incidents/quiet-window-v2-postmortem.md

taylor: thanks. I'll post a preflight to #incidents 1h before start and follow up with a short summary after. :white_check_mark:

nina: good luck, team. :rocket:
